findings.title: Generic project PUT accepts replacement/removal of frozen quote price
findings.currentBehavior: Handler preserves old snapshot only for produced transition with omitted snapshot; same-status quoted/accepted update can replace it. Storage deletes old quote_snapshots then inserts supplied payload, or none if omitted.
findings.expectedBehavior: Server-authoritative committed transitions across all entrypoints, not only dedicated endpoints.
findings.businessImpact: Frozen quote price is not authoritative against alternate client or stale full-aggregate save.
findings.demoImpact: Frozen quote price is not authoritative against alternate client or stale full-aggregate save.
findings.recommendation: Preserve server frozen snapshot for closed revisions; generate freeze on server; explicit versioned amend/reopen commands, regression with crafted same-status PUT.
findings.runtime: NEEDS VERIFICATION: no routed real-DB reproduction completed. Source path independently inspected by root.
findings.scope: Authorized same-organization actor allowed to mutate project. No cross-tenant access, credential bypass or data leakage claim.
findings.priority: P0 before relying on accepted/frozen quote authority in live demo
proposedAcceptanceCriteria: Create and accept quote with server-derived snapshot.
Same-status generic PUT cannot replace, omit/delete or tamper with frozen prices.
Authorized explicit reopen/amend path changes snapshot according to exact revision policy.
Reload confirms snapshot and audit persist; cost-hidden caller does not erase snapshot.

findings.title: Generic aggregate physical writer bypasses dedicated assembly/QC authority
findings.currentBehavior: Generic update writes client part_instances/module_units/production_release without dedicated gates. Web awaits advance endpoint, discards returned authoritative object and locally advances then persists entire project through patch.
findings.expectedBehavior: Server-authoritative committed transitions across all entrypoints, not only dedicated endpoints.
findings.businessImpact: Stale Web saves or authorized generic writes can overwrite gated physical state; dedicated row-lock protection alone is insufficient.
findings.demoImpact: Stale Web saves or authorized generic writes can overwrite gated physical state; dedicated row-lock protection alone is insufficient.
findings.recommendation: Remove physical/release fields from generic mutation authority; hydrate exact server result after command; test generic PUT denial plus stale-client concurrency.

findings.scope: Authorized same-organization actor allowed to mutate project. No cross-tenant access, credential bypass or data leakage claim.
findings.priority: P0 before claiming live physical workflow gates
proposedAcceptanceCriteria: Generic PUT rejects or preserves physical/release state; cannot move awaiting-parts to assembled or bypass packaging QC.
Dedicated endpoint response replaces local state without triggering generic PUT.
Stale generic client save cannot revert a second operator physical advance.
Same-org role denial, exact revision, rollback and audit verified through routed real-DB tests.

findings.title: Quote status and metadata report success before rejected persistence
findings.currentBehavior: Project patch updates memory then starts unawaited save; changeProjectStatus immediately toasts accepted/frozen. Failure emits error but does not restore project. Metadata save has same success-before-save pattern.
findings.expectedBehavior: Server-authoritative committed transitions across all entrypoints, not only dedicated endpoints.
findings.businessImpact: Sales can believe accepted/frozen quote persisted when server rejected it; reload may lose visible progress.
